styles.name: Vox Explainer
styles.inspiration: Vox-style animated documentary / explainer. Paper-collage of old engravings and halftone photos, masked and outlined; high-contrast serif type; one signature blue shape per beat; hand-drawn arrows; choppy low-shutter stop-motion with camera moves into shallow 3D depth. Reference images in references/.

palette.notes: 5 symbolic colors: warm paper, warm ink, AIS blue (the eye-magnet), editorial red, cutout orange. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Fraunces (300 + 900 italic) is the statement voice; Archivo is metadata; Caveat is handwritten margin notes only.

styles.name: Kallaway
styles.inspiration: Kallaway-style premium dark creator explainer. Near-black cool canvas with a blue 'aurora' glow blooming from below; glassmorphism cards and pills; edge-lit neon frames; gradient glow text; focus-stack blur; smooth After-Effects easing (glide + bloom + breathe, never choppy). Palette is the AIS brand — blue is the hero glow where the references used purple. Reference frames in references/.

palette.notes: Dark cool canvas (#0A0E14 / deep #07121C), cream/white text, AIS blue hero glow, yellow secondary pop, red/orange punctuation. One saturated glow per beat. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Plus Jakarta Sans (600-800) is the glow headline/number voice; Inter (400-600) is body/labels; Space Mono is data chips/timestamps/percentages. No serif.

templates.name: 深色方格紙範本
templates.desc: A full-screen dark-mode graph paper takeover for text overlays: near-black matte paper, faint measured grid lines, subtle cyan/green light, and low-contrast procedural texture that shifts like a scanner passing over technical paper. Motion should be ambient, precise, text-safe, and loop cleanly over an eight-second cycle.
